note.text: A simple sentence has one independent clause; it can still have a compound subject or verb. A compound sentence has at least two independent clauses. A complex sentence has an independent clause and at least one dependent clause. A compound-complex sentence combines at least two independent clauses with a dependent clause. Length and the mere presence of and do not determine the type. A comma alone does not normally join independent clauses in formal writing; use an appropriate conjunction or punctuation.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to classify clause relationships and revise sentence structure without changing its meaning. Builds on: conjunctions and coherent narrative. Leads to: error diagnosis and descriptive control.

sections.heading: Understand the pattern
sections.text: A simple sentence has one independent clause; it can still have a compound subject or verb. A compound sentence has at least two independent clauses. A complex sentence has an independent clause and at least one dependent clause. A compound-complex sentence combines at least two independent clauses with a dependent clause. Length and the mere presence of and do not determine the type. A comma alone does not normally join independent clauses in formal writing; use an appropriate conjunction or punctuation.

sections.heading: Read the original model
sections.text: Lower Sixth extension: clause count and dependency determine sentence structure, not length. Bih and Tabe checked and filed the notice can remain a simple sentence despite its coordinated subjects and verbs. Bih checked the notice, but Tabe waited has independent clauses. Because the hall was locked, they waited includes dependency. Vary structure to express time, reason or contrast accurately; do not label every long sentence complex.

sections.heading: Apply and check
sections.text: Mark the boundaries, identify clauses that can stand independently and note dependent markers. Check whether and joins words, phrases or clauses. When repairing a comma splice, preserve the intended relationship rather than inserting any connector at random.

example: Every sentence containing and is compound. Correction: And can join subjects within a single clause.
